revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company under fixed-price IT Service Agreements for platform customization and integration, data migration and content management, and enterprise-level data security services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sign IT Service Agreement with the customers, to provide a series of services include (i) platform customization and integration services, helping customers to design, modify and integrate functionalities in their own systems, (ii) data migration and content management services, assisting customers in their large-scale data migration and content liability management, and (iii) enterprise-level data security services, providing customers with advanced information security technologies
